g.title: FRR DCI: four border handoffs on Ethernet4
ATD dual data center physical topology with FRR transport
g.desc: All 52 links match clab/topology.clab.yml. FRR eth1 and eth2 connect to Site 1 border leaves; eth3 and eth4 connect to Site 2 border leaves. Every border handoff uses Ethernet4. Numbered switch ports are Ethernet ports.

svg.title: ATD dual data center physical and L3LS topology with FRR DCI
